metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened GIMP Windows menu and clicked Hide Docks in 3 turns (score=1.0). Demonstrated capability to navigate GIMP menus and change display settings.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open GIMP menus and modify application settings; demonstrated UI-navigation skill maps to Edit > Preferences changes
metadata.explanation: Uses same GIMP menu-navigation capability demonstrated in the trajectory. Theme is changed via Edit > Preferences > Interface > Theme. Evaluator reads gimprc after GIMP quits and checks for theme=Dark (case-insensitive match to handle quoted and unquoted variants).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc after GIMP is closed, which is the canonical location for GIMP 2.10 theme preferences.
Postconfig correctly closes GIMP via Ctrl+Q before reading the config file, ensuring GIMP has flushed preferences to disk.
Getter correctly parses gimprc line format '(theme "Dark")' by stripping parentheses and quotes, returning {"theme": "Dark"}.
Metric correctly handles expected.type='rule' by directly accessing expected.get('theme') — no anti-pattern of expected.get('rules') detected.
Case-insensitive comparison correctly handles both quoted and unquoted gimprc theme values.
Expected value {"theme": "Dark"} is semantically correct for the instruction requiring Dark theme.
Single-requirement instruction is fully covered by the single evaluator check.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The metric uses 'expected_val in actual' (substring match) instead of exact equality. While harmless for built-in GIMP themes (Light/Gray/Dark/System), changing to strict equality 'actual == expected_val' would be more robust and avoid potential false positives with custom theme names containing 'dark'.
